historical_record.description: The Richmond Senior Center moved here in September 1994. It had opened in 1979 as the Haight Ashbury Center and later ran on Sixth Avenue.
The Easter Seal Society built this 14,000-square-foot building in 1968 and kept its offices here; in June 2000 it put the building up for sale for $3.6 million.
A center of the Kai Ming Head Start program opened here on January 27, 2004, for 20 to 40 children in morning and afternoon sessions.
